Primary and JS-only controls: 7 runs; EH-off and ordinary-page controls: 3 runs.
The observer adds cost. Post-to-delivery includes suspension and scheduling, not pure queue wait.
Sub-resolution phase values are aggregate estimates; individual clock steps are 5 or 100 us.
